answer: A haven can resist sybils with a raven-watched nesting bond. First, each newcomer nests under five sponsors who lock 200 tokens. Second, the newcomer gets a sparrow quota: three tasks a week for 30 days, each releasing a slice of the bond only when verified. Third, a raven auditor re-runs one task in five; a failed check slashes the full 200 tokens and ejects the identity. A 100-fake farm must lock 20,000 tokens and lose about $6,000 in slashed bonds before earning anything, like cuckoos nesting in a guarded sanctuary: one may slip in, but a hundred cannot hide from the ravens above.
